tools.name: whoami

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: Every field Audora needs, with its exact limit in characters or words, the closed list to choose from where there is one, and the accepted file formats and sizes. tools.name: get_track
tools.description: One track with its billed artists and its song credits.

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: Every album in this account, newest first.

tools.name: check_readiness
tools.description: For one track or one album: everything Audora still needs before that release could be submitted, and anything worth a second look that does not block it. That includes the stores' intake rules, checked against the uploaded master and cover themselves (a stereo WAV, FLAC or Apple Lossless master at

tools.description: Runs Audora's own lookup of what the artist has already published (streaming profiles, releases, their site and social profiles), or reads where one is and what it found. Use it only when you cannot search the web yourself: otherwise look the artist up with your own search, check with them that you

tools.name: propose_profile
tools.description: Puts a finished find_online lookup in front of the artist in Audora and returns the link to it. The artist confirms it is them and keeps what is right there. This call writes nothing to their profile, and you should not copy the findings into update_profile yourself. Their Home says their assistant

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Set artist details: name, country, genre, tone, description, main markets, Promo's post language, the three bios and links. Send only the fields you are changing. Call get_requirements first for the exact limits. An over-long value is refused with the number it got.

tools.name: create_track
tools.description: Create a track from its metadata. The audio and the cover art are uploaded separately. Pass idempotency_key if you might retry, so a timeout does not leave two tracks.

tools.name: update_track
tools.description: Amend a track's metadata. Refused once its release has been submitted: a submitted release carries a frozen copy, and changing the catalog underneath it is the artist's own decision, because it costs credits.

tools.name: set_track_credits
tools.description: Replace a track's song credits with this list. Every track needs at least one songwriter, one performer and one producer before its release can be submitted. These are real people: ask the artist, and never invent a name to satisfy the requirement.

tools.name: set_track_artists
tools.description: Replace the OTHER artists a track is billed to: the "Artist & Guest feat. Guest" line on every store. The account's own artist is always billed first and cannot be removed. Do not send it (a name equal to it is dropped, never printed twice). Send the others in billing order. `primary` and `with` joi

tools.name: create_album
tools.description: Create an album or EP. Put tracks on it afterward with set_album_tracks.

tools.name: update_album
tools.description: Amend an album's details. Refused once its release has been submitted.

tools.name: set_album_tracks
tools.description: Put these tracks on this album, in this order. Replaces whatever was on it. A track left out is taken off the album, not deleted.

tools.name: request_upload
tools.description: Ask for a one-time address to upload a master, cover art, a logo or an artist photo to. You need the file's NAME, nothing else. Never ask the artist how big a file is. tools.description: Write the release details for a track or album as a DRAFT. A draft costs nothing, can be changed and goes nowhere until the artist says so. Returns a draft_hash identifying exactly what you prepared, and release_rules: everything the track or album still needs to meet the stores' rules (master forma

tools.name: get_release_questions
tools.description: Questions Audora's reviewers asked about the artist's releases (for example, whether the rights to a remix are cleared), with the whole conversation. A release with an unanswered question does not go out until the artist answers. Omit release_id for every open question.

tools.name: answer_release_question
tools.description: Send the ARTIST'S answer to a question Audora asked about their release (see get_release_questions). Ask the artist and relay what they say. tools.description: Every release in this account with where it has reached (status_label: Draft, Submitted, Changes asked, Going to the stores, Ready for release day, Live, Rejected, Takedown asked, Taken down, Released elsewhere), including anything Audora asked about.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: Every Promo campaign in this account, with its window, whether it is ahead, running or over, and how many posts are to look at, scheduled, posted or did not go out. tools.name: get_campaign
tools.description: One campaign as Promo's calendar: every post by day and lane, with its words, hashtags, picture or video, status, and schedule_check: exactly what Audora's Schedule would decide about it now, and in the artist's words what it still needs.

tools.name: promo_this_week
tools.description: What goes out in the next days across every campaign, what in that time is not scheduled yet (and so will not go out unless it is), and what did not go out lately and needs the artist. last_week: the week that ended, as the Last week sheet on Promo shows it: each post that went out with its numbers

tools.name: promo_results

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start a campaign for an upcoming release, or a month between releases (between_releases: true, from tomorrow; none starts by itself, so start the next month the same way when one ends). A release already out gets no campaign of its own: its start is made between releases with its song first (the ans

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Change a post's words, hashtags, link, day, time, its picture or video (from the Library), or the angle its words take. Send only what changes. Returns the post with schedule_check: what Schedule would decide now. A post already scheduled can be changed only with the schedule permission; one already

tools.name: keep_post
tools.description: Bring a skipped post, or one that did not go out, back as a draft to schedule. A draft is already kept.

tools.name: skip_post
tools.description: Skip a post so it does not go out. It stays on the campaign and keep_post brings it back. Skipping a post that is already scheduled takes it out of the queue and returns its posting credit, and needs the schedule permission.

tools.name: add_post
tools.description: Add a post to a campaign on one lane and day, as Promo's + does, with its words, the angle they take and a picture or video from the Library if you have them. It is a post on its own, not part of a moment, and a draft until it is scheduled.

tools.name: list_todos
tools.description: Every open to-do the artist sees on their pages, most urgent first: what it is, how urgent, where it is fixed and the tool that fixes it from here. Each has a key; closable says whether close_todo can close it.

tools.name: close_todo
tools.description: Close one to-do the artist does not want to see, exactly as closing it in Audora does: it comes back by itself when what it is about changes. A track's or album's missing details are not closed: they are fixed.

tools.name: list_release_todos
tools.description: With release_id: the release's "Around the release" checklist (pitch, pre-save, Canvas, lyrics, release day and the weeks after), each with when it is due, why, where it is done and whether it is done. Without: the artist's "Set up once" list (Instagram ready to post, photos and clips for the posts,

tools.name: set_todo_done
tools.description: Mark one checklist item done, or not done again: the tick in Audora.

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: The artist's pictures or videos in Audora's Library, newest first, searchable by name and filterable by category (Brand kit, Logo, Cover art, Promo, a platform, Made by Audora, Uploaded, Found online, Stock footage). Each has a media_asset_id (what update_post takes) and a preview link valid for an

tools.name: set_first_listen
tools.description: Switch a release on or off the list other artists on Audora see on release day, to give it a first listen. Refused for a release out more than four weeks ago or released elsewhere.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: The shows, release parties and listening parties the artist has posted, with who is invited and who is coming, and their drafts (saved, not posted, seen by nobody else). Artist connections only: Scene is between artists.

tools.name: save_event
tools.description: Save the artist's own show, release party or listening party, or change one (pass event_id). It is saved as a DRAFT that only the artist sees, with whatever is known (only kind is needed), unless you pass post: true. Posting puts it on Scene for artists on Audora (and on the public page when is_publ

tools.name: cancel_event
tools.description: Cancel one of the artist's events. Everyone invited or coming is told. Artist connections only.

tools.name: find_my_music
tools.description: Find which artist on Deezer (and Apple Music) is this artist, to bring their released records in: the confirmed one, or candidates to show the artist. A link to their music (Deezer, Spotify or Apple, artist or record) searches from that instead of the name.

tools.name: confirm_my_music
tools.description: "That's me": record the candidates the ARTIST said are theirs (a catalog can be split across pages). Only ids find_my_music offered. Ask the artist. Never confirm on a guess.

tools.name: preview_catalog_import
tools.description: The records of the confirmed artist, newest first and 50 a page, with their codes, date and type, matched against the catalog: new, already in the catalog, or in conflict with another account. total says how many there are in all. Also the plan's room for songs and albums.

tools.name: import_catalog
tools.description: Start bringing the chosen records into the catalog, within the plan's room. Covers come in only when the artist said they are theirs to use (rights_confirmed: true, their own words, recorded as their consent); otherwise every record comes in with its codes and the cover is left to upload.

tools.name: catalog_import_status
tools.description: The latest import (or the one named): how many records are in, and each record's outcome.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design_in_audora, get_stats, send_feedback, list_campaigns, get_campaign, list_release_todos · Private data: get_requirements, report_gap, request_upload, finalize_upload, find_my_music, confirm_my_music, preview_catalog_import, import_catalog, catalog_import_status · Public sink: design_in_audora, send_feedback, update_profile, set_track_artists, request_upload, finalize_upload, answer_release_question, get_campaign, promo_this_week, start_campaign, update_post, keep_post, skip_post, add_post, list_release_todos, save_event, import_catalog · Destructive: request_upload, save_release_draft, start_campaign.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design_in_audora, get_stats, send_feedback, list_campaigns, get_campaign, list_release_todos · Private data: get_requirements, report_gap, request_upload, finalize_upload, find_my_music, confirm_my_music, preview_catalog_import, import_catalog, catalog_import_status · Public sink: design_in_audora, send_feedback, update_profile, set_track_artists, request_upload, finalize_upload, answer_release_question, get_campaign, promo_this_week, start_campaign, update_post, keep_post, skip_post, add_post, list_release_todos, save_event, import_catalog · Destructive: request_upload, save_release_draft, start_campaign

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
